name: orchestrator-board
about: The board's Orchestrator panel and wait chains (docs/phases/08-orchestrator.md, piece 5). c waits on b, which waits on a: c's card follows the chain to a ('waiting on #2 → #1 → …') and says what holds it up, needs you once a asks a question. Before the orchestrator acts the board has no panel; after it escalates a, raises b's priority and writes a note, the panel shows the open escalation, the actions with their reasons and the note (markdown rendered, HTML escaped). Answering a closes the escalation.

body.text: Is a list of ids enough?
body.reason: a product call blocking two items

steps.board_orchestrator: (?s)Orchestrator · last action [^<]* · 1 open escalation.*Open escalations.*#1 Is a list of ids enough\? · recommends: yes, <keep it simple>.*Recent actions.*#2 Plan turns: patched · because two items wait on it.*#1 Plans table: escalated.*Notebook.*#1 holds up #2 and #3 <b>x</b>

steps.text: a list of ids is fine
